category_edits.rationale: Retain the 0.8 recurrent-state plus 0.2 causal-mean readout, with pooling half-life 3+clamp((n_t-16)/32,0,1), where n_t counts observed nonpadding inputs through position t. Longer prefixes gradually retain broader interests. Apply the same readout across all four category models and synchronize predictor metadata.

edits.find:
positions = torch.arange(seq.size(1), device=seq.device)
        distances = positions[:, None] - positions[None, :]
        weights = torch.exp2(-distances.clamp(min=0).to(out.dtype) / 3.0)
        weights = weights.masked_fill(distances < 0, 0.0)
        real = seq.ne(0).to(out.dtype).unsqueeze(-1)
        numerator = torch.matmul(weights, out * real)
        denominator = torch.matmul(real.squeeze(-1), weights.transpose(0, 1)).unsqueeze(-1)
        mean = numerator / denominator.clamp(min=torch.finfo(out.dtype).tiny)
        return (0.8 * out + 0.2 * mean) * real
edits.replace:
positions = torch.arange(seq.size(1), device=seq.device)
        distances = positions[:, None] - positions[None, :]
        real = seq.ne(0).to(out.dtype).unsqueeze(-1)
        prefix_lengths = real.squeeze(-1).cumsum(dim=1)
        half_lives = 3.0 + ((prefix_lengths - 16.0) / 32.0).clamp(min=0.0, max=1.0)
        weights = torch.exp2(
            -distances.clamp(min=0).to(out.dtype).unsqueeze(0)
            / half_lives.unsqueeze(-1)
        )
        weights = weights.masked_fill((distances < 0).unsqueeze(0), 0.0)
        numerator = torch.matmul(weights, out * real)
        denominator = torch.matmul(weights, real)
        mean = numerator / denominator.clamp(min=torch.finfo(out.dtype).tiny)
        return (0.8 * out + 0.2 * mean) * real
